attempts.summary: Repaired and ran the UDP meter collector on node1. It validates nonnegative decimal sequence/readings, appends valid unique records, suppresses duplicate meter/sequence keys across restarts, and logs malformed datagrams separately. The original west,1,42 reading survived collector and node restarts. Both nodes were rebooted individually and fully recovered on Ubuntu 16.04 with kernel 4.4.0-210.
